title: dg storage sync move-key --json
description: Synced settings moved to a new sync key, or already under the newest one.

status.description: moved: this run moved or finished moving; current: already under the newest key, nothing written.

disabledKeyIds.description: The keys this run disabled; empty when an earlier run or another device already moved.

resealed.description: Slots sealed again under the new key.

created.description: Slots created empty under the new key.

shares.description: Repositories whose shared storage moved to a new epoch.

storedAt.description: Where this computer keeps the key; null when nothing changed.
